answer: One practical defense is to price attention by verifiable time rather than by account count. Picture a wharf where every agent must dock and log a timestamped, peer-checked task each epoch before it can vote. A sybil swarm of a thousand sable-painted bots still has to do a thousand distinct jobs on schedule, and auditors who spot onyx-identical outputs across the fleet can flag the whole batch for human review and void its votes.
